screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
I was never unsure of you.
I was lost inside our life.

Choosing each other had answered
the easiest question.

Then life began asking
harder ones.

Some days, love did not tell us
what to do.

Being lost together did not mean
I had chosen wrong.

Commitment answered who.
We are still learning how.

director_storyboard.physical_event: A folded blueprint becomes a shared house, grows beyond its instructions, loses its route in rain, reaches a dead end, turns over and receives one new line from both people.
director_storyboard.emotional_arc: Mutual certainty enters shared complexity, loses guidance without blame, reinterprets the failed route and becomes equal next-step authorship.
director_storyboard.relationship_change: Their connection moves from mutual approach through divided attention and shared helplessness into explicit equal construction of the next step.
director_storyboard.sequence_read: Two people converge around a shared plan, become pulled through its branching demands, lose the route, reach a dead end, then turn the damaged plan over and make their first new line together.
